title: Mansfield Park
author: Jane Austen
summary: Fanny Price, a poor relation raised among wealthy cousins at Mansfield Park, quietly holds to her principles as the arrival of the charming Crawford siblings disrupts the household and tests her loyalties.
readIf: you like Austen's moral seriousness and a quiet, steady heroine.
skipIf: you want the sparkle and quick wit of Pride and Prejudice.
